title: POWERBENCH: MEASURING LANGUAGE MODEL BIAS IN POWER-SHIFTING REQUESTS
reasoning: The paper introduces PowerBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate language models' responses to 'power-shifting' requests (e.g., self-empowerment, disempowerment, and power grabbing). While it measures biases relating to geopolitics, nationality, user identity, and language, it does not explicitly focus on evaluating or benchmarking religion, moral pluralism, or ethical reasoning.
